item: R822 (row 401): every network consent gate fails closed
summary: ensureOnline and ensureAiEgress wrap their dialog steps (_ensureOnlineAsk, _ensureAiEgressAsk): only an explicit true starts an action; a throw or any non-boolean answer refuses with one message x12; Stay offline stays silent. The 18 optional 'typeof ensureOnline === function &&' gates in src/static became fail-closed '!== function ||' (a missing gate starts nothing; held downloads stay held, R772). A missing AI-egress dialog counts as not completed; _postGoOnline returns r.online === true. A source guard forbids the optional shapes (incl. a condition split across lines, ternary, || default, a discarded answer) and a node harness runs the shipped gates. No new egress; no change while the gate answers.
